description: A Hebrew-language short on the first hire, for a Hebrew-publishing client. Pre-read 2026-09-14 (SCRUM-437): the script said השכירה הראשונה, which in Hebrew is a rental, not a person you hire; every occurrence is now הגיוס הראשון / העובד הראשון, the words a Hebrew founder would use. A reference output must not teach the model a mistranslation. Exists so an English script shipped to a Hebrew client is a measurable failure rather than something a person notices by eye, and so the voice, shot and pitch lints are exercised on Hebrew words (the stock queries stay English: the library is). Three beats, 20 seconds, every sentence under a breath. Endorsed 2026-09-24 by Shlomi after a read for natural Hebrew: the last beat said למי שאתם הופכים להיות (a calque of "who you are becoming"), now לחברה שאתם הולכים להיות; the caption's שאלו/תגייסו mixed two registers, now one.
